name: Reverse Index Map for Voxel Location
definition: A technique to determine the voxel location in volume coordinates (V) from the fragment location in the framebuffer plus current slice z-offset, using a reverse index map (P->V).
summary: The Reverse Index Map for Voxel Location determines volume voxel coordinates from framebuffer fragments and slice offsets, enabling fast interactive manipulation by mapping screen positions to volume data.
